inference-methods.text: Engineers are deploying on-policy distillation, Disaggregated Quantization, CompKV, and just-in-time state management to slash memory overhead and scale test-time reasoning on resource-constrained hardware.

silicon.text: Practitioners are optimizing TPU v6e and low-cost FPGA hardware, mitigating GPU cluster power surges via software, and scaling AI with DRAM/SSD offloading and optical interconnects.
